keys: closedThis panel is closed or saving. Open settings again.
commandLanguage and timezone for public server messages
conflictSettings have changed. Current values: {language}, {timezone}. Open the panel again.
expiredThis editor has expired. Open settings again.
invalid_zoneUnknown IANA timezone. Examples: Europe/Moscow or Asia/Krasnoyarsk.
owner_onlyThis panel belongs to someone else. Open /settings.
permissionYou need Manage Server permission to change server settings.
reminderChoose a language and timezone for personal replies and your voice profile in /settings.
reminder_disabledI will not remind you again. Settings are available in /settings.
reminder_expiredThis reminder has already been handled.
reminder_laterOkay. Settings are available in /settings whenever you need them.
zone_helpFor example Europe/Moscow. Leave blank to use the installation default.
